main_estimator_selection: median_image fixed before this evaluation; no test-based selection

estimators.median_image: median of per-image median GT/raw-prediction ratios
estimators.log_mean: pooled-pixel squared log error; no output clipping in fit objective
estimators.least_squares: pooled-pixel squared metric error; no output clipping in fit objective
estimators.image_absrel_unclipped: image-equal AbsRel weighted median; no output clipping in fit objective

protocol.operation_order: multiply raw prediction by frozen scale, then clip
